basic_details.job_title: Mumbai Port Authority Senior Assistant Traffic Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Four posts of Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager in the pay scale of Rs. 50000-160000 are to be filled in Mumbai Port Authority (MbPA) on deputation, only from officers of Major Port Authorities. Applications in the prescribed format (Annexure II) are forwarded through proper channel by the officer's own Port to the Manager(HR), HR Division, Mumbai Port Authority, Mumbai, and must reach on or before 18 December 2026 (Recruitment Notice No. GAD/P/RECT-Sr.ATM/4447 dated 18 November 2026).

qualification.details: All 4 vacancies are for one post, Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager, in the pay scale of Rs. 50000-160000 (pre revised Rs. 20600-46500/Rs. 10750-16750). The eligibility conditions come from the Recruitment Rules at Annexure I, and the crucial date for deciding eligibility based on qualification, experience and age is 1 November 2026. | Who can apply: eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other criteria as per the Recruitment Rules. Feeder grade for deputation: absorption/deputation will be of officers holding analogous posts or the post of Assistant Manager Gr-I in the scale of pay of Rs. 9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust. Educational qualification: a degree from a recognized university. The Recruitment Rules state that the educational qualification prescribed for direct recruits applies in the case of absorption/deputation. Experience for direct recruits: five years experience in shipping/cargo operations/railway transportation in executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking. The Recruitment Rules state that this experience requirement does not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. Age: the upper age limit of 35 years is printed for direct recruitment; the Recruitment Rules state that the age requirement for direct recruits does not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. Classification: Class-I, selection post, with a period of probation of 2 years as printed in the Recruitment Rules. Method of recruitment (Recruitment Rules): by promotion from Asstt. Traffic Manager Gr-I in the scale of Rs. 9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, failing which by absorption/deputation, failing both by direct recruitment. Deputation period: 3 years. | Candidates should check the Recruitment Rules at Annexure I of the official notification for the complete eligibility of the post.

important_instructions: Applications should be sent through proper channel only. Incomplete or unsigned applications, applications without relevant documentary proof, or applications received after the due date will not be considered, without any communication. No action will be taken on an advance copy of the application submitted by candidates. The Management reserves the right to cancel or make any changes in the recruitment process, if need arises, without further notice and without assigning any reason. If any information in the application is found false or incorrect, the candidature/appointment may be cancelled or terminated without notice (declaration in the form). The circular with its annexures is also available on the MbPA website www.mumbaiport.gov.in. The letterhead gives the phone number 91-22-6656 5656.

content_sections.heading: About MbPA Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager
content_sections.text: Mumbai Port Authority is a Major Port Authority with its General Administration Department at Port House, 2nd floor, S.V. Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai - 400 001. The notice was issued by the Manager (HR), C. Premakumari, to the Chairpersons of all Major Port Authorities. The four vacant posts are being filled with the approval of the Competent Authority under the MbPTE (RS&P) Regulations, 2010, by deputation from amongst officers of Major Port Authorities. The Recruitment Rules at Annexure I place the post in the Traffic Department (including Railway).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is not sent directly by the officer. It must be submitted in the prescribed format (Annexure II) through proper channel, and the concerned Port forwards it along with the documents listed under Enclosures. Fill the Annexure II application form and paste a photograph of 3.5 cm x 3.5 cm in the space given. Sign the declaration that the particulars are true, that you will not withdraw if selected and that you undertake to accept the posting. Submit the form to your own Port through proper channel; the Port verifies the certificates and attaches the clearances. The envelope is superscribed: "Application for the post of Sr. Asstt. Traffic Manager in Mumbai Port Authority". The Port sends it to: Manager(HR), HR Division, Mumbai Port Authority, 2nd Floor, Port Bhavan, S. V. Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai – 400001. The application must reach this office on or before 18 December 2026; the concerned Port should ensure this. The Annexure II form asks for: full name in block letters, address for communication, telephone/mobile number, fax/e-mail address, date of birth, date of retirement, category (SC/ST/OBC/GEN, with caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC), whether a Caste Validity/Verification Certificate has been obtained (copy to be attached if yes), present post with scale of pay, date of continuous appointment and date of first appointment in the present post, educational qualifications (graduation certificate and higher professional qualification certificate to be enclosed), details of qualifying service, employment history in chronological order, languages known, achievements and any other information. In the qualifying service table, only regular service is counted, under the columns regular basis, officiating basis and against temporary post. A pay scale granted as financial upgradation under the Modified Assured Career Progression Scheme (MACP) should not be shown, as it is not regular service in the grade. All columns must be clearly filled in.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 4 vacancies are for one post, Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager, in the pay scale of Rs. 50000-160000 (pre revised Rs. 20600-46500/Rs. 10750-16750). The eligibility conditions come from the Recruitment Rules at Annexure I, and the crucial date for deciding eligibility based on qualification, experience and age is 1 November 2026. Who can apply: eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other criteria as per the Recruitment Rules. Feeder grade for deputation: absorption/deputation will be of officers holding analogous posts or the post of Assistant Manager Gr-I in the scale of pay of Rs. 9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust. Educational qualification: a degree from a recognized university. The Recruitment Rules state that the educational qualification prescribed for direct recruits applies in the case of absorption/deputation. Experience for direct recruits: five years experience in shipping/cargo operations/railway transportation in executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking. The Recruitment Rules state that this experience requirement does not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. Age: the upper age limit of 35 years is printed for direct recruitment; the Recruitment Rules state that the age requirement for direct recruits does not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. Classification: Class-I, selection post, with a period of probation of 2 years as printed in the Recruitment Rules. Method of recruitment (Recruitment Rules): by promotion from Asstt. Traffic Manager Gr-I in the scale of Rs. 9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, failing which by absorption/deputation, failing both by direct recruitment. Deputation period: 3 years. Candidates should check the Recruitment Rules at Annexure I of the official notification for the complete eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The concerned Port forwards the application along with these documents: Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD. A statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs/APARs and grading, signed by the HoD or Secretary. If an ACR/APAR for a particular year or period is not available, a "No Report Certificate" may be attached along with the ACRs/APARs of the preceding years. Attested copies of all certificates as proof of educational qualification and of experience in the respective post and pay scale, verified by the Port while forwarding the application. No Objection Certificate from the respective Port. An undertaking by the applicant that the candidature will not be withdrawn if selected by the Services Selection Committee. Administrative Clearance of the concerned Port, filled, signed and stamped by the Head of the Department (proforma at Annexure III). Vigilance Clearance in the format at Annexure IV. If any major or minor penalty was imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, the disciplinary case leading to it, with the necessary documents, may be sent by the forwarding authority with the application. Two passport size photographs (the Hindi version adds: recent, placed in a transparent envelope and labelled). The form also notes that the applicant may enclose self-attested copies of certificates for educational and other qualifications, and copies of documents supporting employment in organisations other than major port trusts. In the Annexure III certificate, the Head of Department certifies that the particulars are correct, that no disciplinary/vigilance case is pending or contemplated, the officer's integrity, that no major/minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years (or the details if any), that attested APARs from 1.4.2020 to 31.3.2025 are enclosed, and that the officer meets the qualification and experience criteria of Annexure I. The Annexure IV vigilance form has Part A filled by the HR Department (Annual Property Return, disciplinary proceedings, punishment, police cases, vigilance complaints) and Part B filled by the Vigilance Department, signed by the CVO/Dy. CVO.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MbPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mumbai Port Authority has 4 vacant posts of Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager to be filled on deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the MbPA Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager application?
faq.answer: Applications forwarded through proper channel must reach the Manager(HR), Mumbai Port Authority on or before 18 December 2026. Late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager post at Mumbai Port Authority?
faq.answer: Only eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities can apply: officers holding analogous posts or the post of Assistant Manager Gr-I in the scale of Rs. 9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for MbPA Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager?
faq.answer: A degree from a recognized university is required, and this qualification applies to deputation as well. Eligibility is decided as on 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an age limit for deputation to this post?
faq.answer: The Recruitment Rules print an upper age limit of 35 years for direct recruitment and state that this age requirement does not apply in the case of absorption/deputation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale of MbPA Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager?
faq.answer: The post carries the pay scale of Rs. 50000-160000 (pre revised Rs. 20600-46500/Rs. 10750-16750).

faq.question: Q7. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation period for the Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager posts in Mumbai Port Authority will be 3 years.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the MbPA Sr. Assistant Traffic Manager post?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure II form and submit it through proper channel; your Port forwards it with the listed documents to Manager(HR), HR Division, Mumbai Port Authority, 2nd Floor, Port Bhavan, S. V. Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai – 400001.

faq.question: Q9. What should be written on the envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope must be superscribed "Application for the post of Sr. Asstt. Traffic Manager in Mumbai Port Authority".

faq.question: Q10. Will an advance copy sent directly by the candidate be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Mumbai Port Authority will take no action on an advance copy of the application submitted by candidates; only applications through proper channel are considered.
